content: भौत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) [भूतानि प्राणिनोऽधिकृत्य प्रवृत्तः, तानि देवता वा अस्य अण्] .²1 Relating to living beings. .²2 Elemental, material. .²3 Demoniacal. .²4 Mad, crazy. .{@-तः@} .²1 A worshipper of demons and spirits. .²2 An attendant upon an idol (देवल). .²3 One of the five daily Yajñas to be performed by a householder (also called भूतयज्ञ, <ab>q. v.</ab>); होमो दैवो बलिर्भौतो नृयज्ञोऽतिथिपूजनम् <ls>Ms. 3. 70</ls>. .{@-तम्@} A collection of evil spirits. .{@-ती@} Night.
